metadata.title: AlphaFold3 on TPU and GPU: predicted structures, confidences and derived analysis outputs
metadata.description:
Record R2 of the study: the AlphaFold3 v3.0.4 outputs of the 607 sessions of the data freeze d706dffc07fec6d86471e28f062178e4f309193d3bfd6a66de47959eb3bfdd8f, on TPU v5e, TPU v6e, NVIDIA L4, A100, H100 and CPU, covering the main study, follow-ups 1 to 21 and the two later measurements (memlimit_ah, warm_th): predicted structures, confidences (for follow-ups 17 to 21 the summary confidences only, apart from the 20 processes of follow-up 17's check 5), embeddings of follow-up 2, feature arrays of follow-up 5, XLA dumps of follow-up 16, AlphaFold3 logs, the results of AlphaFold3's data pipeline with the three deliveries of follow-up 6, the analysis outputs derived from them with the paper's tables and figures, and, apart, superseded or engineering sessions not used in any reported result.

By using this information, you agree to AlphaFold 3 Output Terms of Use found at https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphafold3/blob/main/OUTPUT_TERMS_OF_USE.md. Non-commercial use only. Any use must cite Abramson, J. et al. Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions with AlphaFold 3. Nature (2024). No Creative Commons licence applies to this record. Every archive holds a Legally Binding Terms of Use text file (LEGALLY_BINDING_TERMS_OF_USE.txt) and a copy of the Terms.

No model parameters are in this record; they are available only from Google DeepMind. Inputs with ColabFold MSAs, data freeze and run records are in the companion record, 10.5281/zenodo.24057470.

Pre-registration on OSF: project https://osf.io/qtz3v, main study https://osf.io/fegsy, addenda of follow-ups 10 (https://osf.io/nsbgp), 11 (https://osf.io/64bpy), 13 (https://osf.io/c4kh7), 14 (https://osf.io/eafkx), 15 (https://osf.io/h9yw8), 16 (https://osf.io/hcxm7), 17 (https://osf.io/x4hry), 18 (https://osf.io/mq8fh), 19 (https://osf.io/4cbgf), 20 (https://osf.io/hjf8z) and 21 (https://osf.io/ctv2d).

Paper: see the related identifiers of this Zenodo record (arXiv preprint and conference version, added when available). The paper's supplementary material is the PDF Pazienza_AlphaFold3_cross_platform_reproducibility_supplement.pdf in this record.
